# Dispenser recurrence test vectors, format v1 (see test-vectors/README.md).
# Consumed by firmware/test/host/test_recurrence_vectors.c (C engine) and
# android/app/src/test/.../RecurrenceVectorTest.kt (Kotlin reference engine).
# Timezone of every record: Europe/Prague (CET = UTC+1, CEST = UTC+2).
# Expected values are hand-derived from the Android unit tests and the IANA rules,
# never generated by the C implementation under test.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- schedules

validate schedule=v_friday     expect=OK
validate schedule=v_end_before expect=END_BEFORE_START
validate schedule=v_end_same   expect=OK
validate schedule=v_multi      expect=AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE,INTERVAL_TOO_SMALL,NO_WEEKDAYS,END_BEFORE_START
validate schedule=v_once_gap   expect=TIME_NONEXISTENT
validate schedule=once_0159    expect=OK

validate schedule=once_overlap expect=OK
validate schedule=daily_gap    expect=OK
validate schedule=weekly_gap   expect=OK
validate schedule=v_big_amount expect=OK
validate schedule=v_id_64      expect=OK
# Firmware canonical-form and range checks. The Kotlin draft validator has no
# equivalent (enforced by Kotlin types or the backup codec), so scope=c.
validate schedule=v_bad_char   expect=ID scope=c
validate schedule=v_long_id    expect=ID scope=c
validate schedule=v_rev0       expect=REVISION scope=c
validate schedule=v_1999       expect=START_DATE scope=c
validate schedule=v_2100_end   expect=END_DATE scope=c
validate schedule=v_feb29      expect=START_DATE scope=c
validate schedule=v_hour24     expect=TIME scope=c
validate schedule=v_min60      expect=TIME scope=c
validate schedule=v_monthly    expect=KIND scope=c
validate schedule=v_int_big    expect=INTERVAL_TOO_LARGE scope=c
validate schedule=v_once_int2  expect=ONCE_FORM scope=c
validate schedule=v_once_end   expect=ONCE_FORM scope=c
validate schedule=v_once_days  expect=WEEKDAYS scope=c

# Missed doses are never caught up: only strictly-future occurrences.
next schedule=daily after=2026-11-24T11:00:00Z expect=2026-11-25@2026-11-25T07:00:00Z
# Start date in the future / query long before the supported range.
next schedule=daily after=1970-01-01T00:00:00Z expect=2026-11-02@2026-11-02T07:00:00Z
next schedule=first_day after=1970-01-01T00:00:00Z expect=2000-01-01@1999-12-31T23:00:00Z
# Local date differs from the UTC date (00:30 CET = 23:30Z the day before).

next schedule=early_0030 after=2026-11-14T23:30:00Z expect=2026-11-16@2026-11-15T23:30:00Z

seq schedule=mo_we_wed after=2026-10-31T23:00:00Z n=2 expect=2026-11-04@2026-11-04T07:00:00Z,2026-11-09@2026-11-09T07:00:00Z

seq schedule=disabled after=2026-11-14T06:00:00Z n=5 expect=-
# Spring forward (28 Mar 2027, 02:00 -> 03:00): 02:30 is skipped that day, never shifted.
seq schedule=spring_0230 after=2027-03-26T23:00:00Z n=3 expect=2027-03-27@2027-03-27T01:30:00Z,2027-03-29@2027-03-29T00:30:00Z,2027-03-30@2027-03-30T00:30:00Z
seq schedule=spring_0330 after=2027-03-27T12:00:00Z n=2 expect=2027-03-28@2027-03-28T01:30:00Z,2027-03-29@2027-03-29T01:30:00Z
# Fall back (25 Oct 2026, 03:00 -> 02:00): 02:30 once, at the earlier instant.
seq schedule=autumn_0230 after=2026-10-23T22:00:00Z n=4 expect=2026-10-24@2026-10-24T00:30:00Z,2026-10-25@2026-10-25T00:30:00Z,2026-10-26@2026-10-26T01:30:00Z,2026-10-27@2026-10-27T01:30:00Z
seq schedule=gap_only after=2027-03-01T11:00:00Z n=3 expect=-
seq schedule=su_spring after=2027-03-20T11:00:00Z n=2 expect=2027-03-21@2027-03-21T01:30:00Z,2027-04-04@2027-04-04T00:30:00Z
seq schedule=su_autumn after=2026-10-19T10:00:00Z n=2 expect=2026-10-25@2026-10-25T00:30:00Z,2026-11-01@2026-11-01T01:30:00Z

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- occurrence identity
# Approved scheme <scheduleId>@<localDate> (FR-014), independent of revision and time of day:
# revision 1 at 08:00 and revision 2 at 20:00 share the identity of 20 Nov.
